content.text:
Operator
Hello, ladies and gentlemen. Welcome to Futu Holdings Q2 2024 Earnings Conference Call. At this time, all participants are in a listen-only mode. After management prepared remarks, there'll be a Q&A session. Today's conference call is being recorded. If you have any objections, you may disconnect at this time. I would now like to turn this conference over to your host for today's conference call, Daniel Yuan, Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR at Futu. Please go ahead, sir.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
Thanks, operator, and thank you for joining us today to discuss our Q2 2024 earnings results. Joining me on the call today are Mr. Leaf Li, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Arthur Chen, Chief Financial Officer, and Robin Xu, Senior Vice President. As a reminder, today's call may include forward-looking statements which represent the company's belief regarding future events, which, by their nature, are not certain and are outside of the company's control. Forward-looking statements involving risk and uncertainties. We caution you that a number of important factors could cause actual results to differ materially from those containing any forward-looking statements. For more information about the potential risks and uncertainties, please refer to the company's filings with the SEC, including its annual report. With that, I will now turn the call over to Leaf. Leaf will make his comments in Chinese, and I will translate.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
Thank you all for joining our earnings call today. In Q2, we acquired 155,000 paying clients, representing 168% year-over-year growth. By the end of the quarter, we crossed the 2 million paying clients milestone, translating into 29% growth year-over-year and 8% growth quarter-over-quarter. Six months into 2024, we have achieved over 80% of our full-year new paying client guidance. Given the strong year-to-date momentum, we would like to raise our guidance again to 550,000 new paying clients in 2024. New paying clients in Hong Kong and Singapore both recorded double-digit sequential growth amid market rebound, collectively contributing to over 1/3 of paying client growth in Q2.
In Japan, new paying clients grew by double-digit quarter-over-quarter as we continue to strengthen product offerings, iterate our marketing initiatives, and increase our brand awareness. Meanwhile, Malaysia maintained strong momentum and contributed the highest number of new paying clients among all markets two quarters in a row despite sequential deceleration. One major product update is our recent launch of cryptocurrency trading in Hong Kong and Singapore. Compared to some other markets we operate in, we believe that the penetration of crypto in Hong Kong and Singapore has much room for growth given their supportive regulatory environment, rising awareness of virtual assets.
The emergence of more user-friendly virtual asset trading platforms. The adoption curve will not be linear, and obviously highly subjective to market sentiments. When we develop our product roadmap, we think less about short-term monetization than offering a broader portfolio of asset classes with low correlation to help our clients navigate market cycles and thus drive higher client wallet share.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
In terms of our product roadmap for other international markets, in Japan, we are on track to launch NISA savings account, mutual funds, and US margin trading in the coming months. In Malaysia, we recently rolled out Ringgit and USD-denominated money market funds. To help our clients capitalize on the vibrant local IPO market in Malaysia, we also launched the Malaysian stock IPO subscription services. In Canada, we just introduced Cash Plus product that enables clients to earn incentives on their idle cash.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
Total client assets jumped 24% year-over-year and 12% quarter-over-quarter to a record HKD 579 billion. The growth was fueled by the robust net asset inflow across markets and the market appreciation of our client stock holdings. With net asset inflow recording rapid sequential growth, we exceeded our full year 2023 number only six months into the year. In Q2, our clients continued to take on more leveraged positions amid uplift market sentiment. As a result, margin financing and securities lending balance climbed to an all-time high of HKD 44 billion.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
Driven by robust net asset inflow into equities and money market funds, total client assets in Singapore grew by 19% quarter-over-quarter, marking the eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Average client assets in Malaysia recorded 45% sequential growth, while total client assets more than doubled. In Australia, average client assets realized sequential growth for three consecutive quarters
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
Growing optimism continued into Q2 for Hong Kong stocks and major US indices notched an all-time high, total trading volume grew to HKD 1.62 trillion, up 69% year-over-year and 21% quarter-over-quarter. For Hong Kong stock trading, client interest persisted through technology and high dividend names. Trading velocity also rebounded sequentially, amid a palpable shift in market sentiment. As a result, Hong Kong stock trading volume increased by 28% sequentially to HKD 358 billion. Boosted by the continued AI mania and resurgence of meme stocks, US stock trading volume grew by 19% quarter-over-quarter to HKD 1.24 trillion. In the US market, advanced options trading tools combined with user-friendly interface, and extensive educational resources, boosted our appeal among options traders.
In Q2, the number of options traders in the US increased by around 60% year-over-year, while the number of options contracts traded more than doubled compared to the year-ago quarter.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
Wealth management recorded another quarter of exceptional growth as our clients saw diversification and continued to park more funds in safer assets like money market funds and US Treasury bills. Total client assets grew by 84% year-over-year and 25% quarter-over-quarter to around HKD 80 billion. As of quarter end, wealth management assets accounted for 14% of our total client assets and over 25% of paying clients held wealth management positions.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
We have 451 IPO distribution and IR clients, up 21% year-over-year. We underwrote seven of the 10 largest Hong Kong IPOs in the H1 of 2024.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
Next, I'd like to invite our CFO, Arthur, to discuss our financial performance.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
Thank you, Leaf and Daniel. Please allow me to walk you through our financial performance in Q2. All the numbers are in HKD unless otherwise noted. Total revenue was HKD 3.1 billion, up 26% from HKD 2.5 billion in Q2 2023. Brokerage commission and handling charge income was HKD 1.4 billion, up 45% year-over-year and 27% quarter-over-quarter. The increase was mainly driven by a 69% year-over-year and a 21% quarter-over-quarter growth in total trading volume. Given our per-share pricing model for US stock trading, the blended commission rate increased from 8.1 basis points to 8.5 basis points. As a result, brokerage income grew at a faster rate than trading volume quarter-over-quarter.
Interest income was HKD 1.6 billion, up 13% year-over-year, and 18% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter increase was mainly driven by higher margin financing income due to an increase in daily average margin balance, and the higher interest income from securities borrowing and the lending business. Other income was HKD 161 million, up 27% year-over-year, and 3% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter increase was both primarily attributable to higher fund distribution income, while the quarter-over-quarter increase was partially offset by the decline in underwriting fee income. Our total costs were HKD 574 million, an increase of 53% from HKD 375 million in Q2 2023.
Brokerage commission and handling charge expenses were HKD 87 million, up 58% year-over-year and 45% quarter-over-quarter. Expenses grew by a wider margin than income sequentially, mainly due to the capped fee scheme for US stock trading. Under the per-share pricing model, we charge a maximum of 50 basis points of trading volume per order for US stock trading. When clients trade a lower priced meme stock, as was the case in Q2, there will be a mismatch between the growth rate of revenue and expenses. Interest expenses was HKD 378 million, up 71% year-over-year, and 21% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter increase was mainly driven by high interest expenses associated with our securities borrowing and lending business.
Processing and the servicing cost was HKD 109 million, up 11% year-over-year and 13% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year increase was largely due to higher product service fee, and the quarter-over-quarter increase was mainly driven by higher market information and data fees. As a result, our total gross profit was HKD 2.6 billion, an increase of 21% from HKD 2.1 billion in Q2 2023. Gross margin was 81.6% as compared to 84.9% in the year-ago quarter. Operating expenses were up 26% year-over-year and 16% quarter-over-quarter to HKD 1.1 billion. R&D expenses was HKD 374 million, up 3% year-over-year and 12% quarter-over-quarter.
The year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter increase was mainly driven by an increase in R&D head count to support our new markets. Selling and marketing expenses was HKD 338 million, up 93% year-over-year and 16% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year increase was driven by the triple-digit year-over-year growth in new paying clients, partially offset by lower client acquisition costs. The quarter-over-quarter increase was mainly due to the sequential increase in client acquisition costs. G&A expenses was HKD 362 million, up 16% year-over-year and 20% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter increase was primarily due to increase in headcount for G&A personnel. As a result, income from operation increased by 18% year-over-year and 24% quarter-over-quarter to HKD 1.5 billion.
Operating margin declined to 47.3% from 50.6% in Q2 2023, mostly due to higher marketing expenses. Our net income increased by 8% year-over-year, and 17% quarter-over-quarter to HKD 1.2 billion. Net income margin declined to 38.6% in the Q2 as compared to 41.1% in the same quarter last year. Our effective tax rate for the quarter was 15.2%. That conclude our prepared remarks. We'd now like to open the call to questions. Operator, please go ahead.
Operator
Thank you. To ask a question during the session, you will need to press star one one on your telephone.
Please wait for your name to be announced. To withdraw your question, please press star one one again. Please stand by while we compile the Q&A roster. We will now take our first question. Please stand by. The first question comes from the line of Cindy Wang from China Renaissance. Please go ahead. Your line is now open.
Cindy Wang
Director of Equity Research, China Renaissance
[Foreign language]
I have two questions. One question is related to crypto services. Recently you have launched the crypto services in Hong Kong and Singapore. Could you provide some color on client feedback on crypto trading and what your client acquisition strategy? Second is basically now around two months for the Q3. Can you give us some latest trend for the Q3, including like trading volume, trading velocity, AUM, and the margin financing and securities lending balance? Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
Thank you, Cindy. [Foreign language]
Despite, you know, there will be some negative impacts, implications from the mark-to-market loss due to the challenges that we face in Hong Kong markets. In terms of, you know, clients' trading turnover velocity and also the trading volume, etc., we have seen that these indicators remain very strong and have a sequential Q-on-Q increase. In terms of the commission rate, given that we got some benefit in Q2, in light that, you know, a lot more clients are trading these low-value meme stocks, which give us some positive uptick in terms of the take rate. Such benefit will become normalized in Q3 so far. Thank you very much.
Operator
Thank you.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
So far, we have a number of clients that have activated their cryptocurrency trading accounts, but because we offered the product not long ago, and because recently the cryptocurrency market experienced very significant pullback and fluctuation, our clients' trading volume of cryptocurrency and client assets are both pretty small in comparison to the scale of the whole business. Right now, our focus is to continue to enhance our product capabilities and continue to provide investor education and operations to further enhance our value proposition as a one-stop asset allocation platform. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question. The next question comes from the line of Chiyao Huang from Morgan Stanley. Please go ahead, your line is now open.
Chiyao Huang
Equity Research Analyst, Morgan Stanley
[Foreign language]
Do you see any acceleration trend in Q2 compared to Q1? How is the trend in Q3 going so far right now? What's currently the per client assets in Japan and where the clients are putting their money at in Japan? Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
Thank you, Tiao. I will take your first question and I will leave the second question to my colleague Daniel.
[Foreign language]
In terms of the you know benefit from our total client assets increase in Q2, our total client assets increased by 12% quarter-over-quarter and to break this down, majority of the contribution actually comes from the clients, as inflows in terms of the top up their accounts on cash or stock transfer, which accounts for roughly you know high single digit contribution and the remaining 2% to 3% belongs to the market, to market positive benefit. Hong Kong and Singapore both these are two key markets in terms of the contribution of new asset inflows which roughly accounts for 80% of our total net asset inflows. Thank you very much.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Overall, in the Q2 we saw very robust net new paying clients in Japan, actually recorded very decent quarter-over-quarter growth, and in terms of the absolute number of paying clients contributed to Japan or Malaysia are in the first tier, so we were very happy with what we saw in Japan in the Q2.
At the quarter end, we had close to 800,000 users, which we think is also a very healthy growth. Previously, we gave the guidance of having 1 to 1.5 million users in Japan by year-end, and we're still very confident about that guidance. In terms of driver for new paying client growth, two things. First of all, it's just to continue to roll out of new products. In comparison to some of the mainstream players in Japan, we still lack a couple of very key financial products. As Leaf mentioned in his opening remarks, we have a plan to offer those products in the next couple of months. Second, brand building is also important, as we've realized and a lot of investors are aware right now, Japan users usually take a bit more time to trust the brand, especially a brand from overseas. That's why we'll continue to invest in our brand, and that's also why we did a power launch and had a brand ambassador in Q2. These all contributed to a higher brand equity, and we'll continue to invest in brand building. In terms of average client assets, right now it's a couple thousand US dollars, and mostly clients still allocated into US stocks, although the percentage of assets in Japan stocks and the percentage of trading volume from Japan stocks have been increasing. We believe that as we continue to enhance our Japan stock product offering, this percentage contribution will continue to go up, closer to the market level. Thank you.
Chiyao Huang
Equity Research Analyst, Morgan Stanley
Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question. Please stand by. The next question comes from the line of You Fan from CICC. Please go ahead, your line is now open.
You Fan
Equity Research Analyst, CICC
[Foreign language]
The first question, what's our plan for new product offerings? Any product pipeline, especially in new markets like Japan and Malaysia? The second question, what's our progress of the share repurchase program?
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
In terms of the product pipeline, for Japan, as Leaf mentioned earlier, a couple of very important financial products for us and also what we intend to roll out in the next couple of months include, number one, NISA savings account, and number two, mutual funds, and thirdly, US margin financing. For Malaysia, I think we kept a very nice pace of new product rollout. In Q3 to date, we've actually rolled out Malaysian stock IPO subscription services and also the Cash Plus product, which is a money market product. From our experience, when the IPO market is very hot, usually IPO subscription service can be a good contributor of new client growth. During the high-rate environment, money market products can help increase client assets. In terms of future product pipeline in Malaysia, we plan to roll out this quarter the stock transfer from Malaysian stocks so that we can attract existing clients at other brokers in Malaysia. Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Our existing share repurchase program actually will cover 2024 and also 2025. So far, we have not exercised this program yet. We will keep you and also other analysts and investors, our shareholders, on post if we exercise any of them. Thank you.
You Fan
Equity Research Analyst, CICC
[Foreign language]
Thanks.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question. Please stand by. The next question comes from the line of Zoey Zong from Jefferies. Please go ahead. Your line is now open.
Zoey Zong
Equity Research Analyst, Jefferies
[Foreign language]
Second, we have seen that interest expenses increased by 21% sequentially in Q2, wondering what's the reason behind and how should we think about the trend going forward. Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
For cryptocurrency trading, since we now only offer the trading services, the business model is pretty straightforward, just we charge a commission. When we design our pricing scheme, we want to balance our market competitiveness and monetization potential. Right now, in Hong Kong and Singapore, we both work with an upstream provider to offer cryptocurrency trading. Under our current pricing model, take into consideration the upstream cost, we still enjoy pretty good gross profit margin. The net take rate of cryptocurrency trading is higher than the net take rate for Hong Kong and US stock trading. Thank you.
Zoey Zong
Equity Research Analyst, Jefferies
Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question, please stand by. The next question comes from the line of Emma Xu from Bank of America Securities. Please go ahead, your line is now open.
Emma Xu
Equity Research Analyst, Bank of America Securities
[Foreign language]
The first question is about the client acquisition. You just raised your full year new paying client target to 550,000, which means you need to acquire around 108,000 new paying client per quarter. Usually your client acquisition is seasonally low in Q4. That implies your Q3 client acquisition is still quite strong. Could you tell us which markets are driving your client growth in Q3? The second question is about, given the rising expectations of rate cut and then the recent wild volatilities in the AI stocks, do you see the changes in client asset allocation, say between the stocks, the bonds, and the options, etc.?
In terms of the allocation within the stocks, say from the AI growth stocks to value stocks, and how will these changing behaviors impact your take rate? Correspondingly, given the rising expectation of rate cuts, how will it impact your interest income? I know it could probably have limited impact on your interest income this year, but what will be, say that 25 basis point rate cut impact on your interest income next year? Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
In Q2, major contributions for the new clients acquired is number one, the Hong Kong and Singapore, which contribute over one third of our new paying clients acquired in Q2. Combined Japan and Malaysia, which accounts for roughly 40% for the whole pie. Based on the quarter-to-date situations, we are still very confident we can achieve the guidance we mentioned before, despite there can be some uncertainties arising from the US election in Q4. We do expect, you know, contribution breakdown from these markets should be similar to what we have witnessed in the H1 of this year.
Of course, for the second question, of course, we got some negative implications, you know, from the rate cut. We have some, you know, preliminary sensitivity estimations. Every, you know, 25 basis point rate cut our pre-tax profit, operating profit, will be impacted by HKD 5 million to 8 million if we did not account any potential positive implications from the market trading volume increase because of the rate hike and also the benefits from the new client acquisitions, you know, for these implications. So far, we have not witnessed a very, you know, significant client asset allocation changes arising from your observations.
In the wealth management universe, we do witness there will be more asset allocations by our clients on the fixed income products, you know, including the treasuries, and also short duration fixed income products, etc. Thank you.
Emma Xu
Equity Research Analyst, Bank of America Securities
Thank you. Very helpful.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question. Please stand by. The next question comes from the line of Charles Zhu from UBS. Please go ahead. Your line is now open.
Charles Zhou
Executive Director and Equity Research Analyst, UBS
[Foreign language]
First of all, congratulations to the management team. I think it's a very strong set of results and also above the consensus. My question is regarding the client acquisition costs. Because I think this is very well managed, do we have any updates for the 2024 full-year guidance? If you don't have any new guidance or any updates, we believe you know there's also a decent, you know, huge upside from here as well. Could you please also share your marketing and also client acquisition strategy in several of the key markets in the H2? My second question is related to the interest income. Our understanding, there are three major components, idle cash interest income, margin financing, stock lending, interest income as well as the IPO financing income. Could you please just help us to split the interest income from these three components for Q2? Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Clients' idle cash and also the margin financing almost contribute equally in terms of the, you know, interest income breakdown. Despite my feeling is, you know, interest income from idle cash will slightly higher than the second part. Thank you very much.
Charles Zhou
Executive Director and Equity Research Analyst, UBS
Okay, that's very helpful, thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question. Please stand by. The next question comes from the line of Peter Zhang from JPMorgan. Please go ahead. Your line is now open.
Peter Zhang
Equity Research Analyst, JPMorgan
[Foreign language]
Many thanks for management giving me the opportunity to ask the question. This is Peter from JPMorgan. I have two questions. My first question is on Malaysia business. I wish management could give us more details on the progress of the Malaysia business. For example, the client's net asset inflow, average client assets, client profile and client's trading turnover, and what's the outlook of the Malaysia business. My second question is about the Airstar Bank. I understand that Futu invest 40% shares into the Airstar Bank in June. We wish to understand what the rationale behind this investment and going forward what's Futu's strategy to cooperating with this virtual bank in Hong Kong. Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Secondly, of course, we do think, you know, in terms of our future strategy directions, there will be a lot of synergy and also same scenarios between the brokerage business, wealth management business in Futu and also the retail banking business and also, you know, high net worth, you know, wealth management business normally provided by the bank. The deal was just completed in Q2. We strive very hard and work very closely with the local management of Airstar Bank alongside with, you know, Xiaomi and other shareholders of Airstar Bank to align our long-term strategy.
Having said that, I think the near-term focus will be more on the product itself, especially, you know, how to, you know, contribute our R&D capabilities and technology capabilities, to further foster and enhance the infrastructure of Airstar Bank's products. Thank you.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
In terms of our client profiles, given our value proposition as a one-stop trading platform for Malaysian and US stocks. So far, the clients we have attracted have some level of investment experience, and most of them are young Asian males and have a higher income level than the country's average number. We've seen that the trading turnover of our Malaysian clients are meaningfully higher than the group average. Given the ARPU and CAC numbers we have seen in Q2, we think the payback period of Malaysia is better than when we first launched in Singapore. As at the end of Q2 across our different cohorts in Malaysia, net asset inflow, average client assets, all were trending up month-over-month, and average client assets was actually up 45% Q1 Q-Q.
As our average client assets in Malaysia continued to increase, we believe the unit economics will continue to improve. In terms of the Q2 client acquisition and the third quarter-to-date trend, the Q2 moomoo paying clients was down a bit sequentially, mostly because of a high base in the first quarter. That's when we were able to convert a large number of our existing users into paying clients. But apart from that, the Q2 growth was very steady QoQ, and we believe the strong momentum is partially due to the spillover of our brand equity accumulated in Singapore, and also because there are leading product capabilities as a one-stop platform for Malaysian US stocks.
Also the strong market sentiment in Q2 also helps with client acquisition. In Q2, we launched a Malaysian stock IPO subscription, and also automatic investment schemes for US stocks and fractional shares for US stocks. For Q3 to date, we launched money market funds and also stock transfer from Malaysian stocks. For Q3, we expect a steady quarter-over-quarter new paying clients growth in Malaysia. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question. Please stand by. The next question comes from the line of Hu Shen from CLSA. Please go ahead. Your line is now open.
Hu Shen
Director, CLSA
[Foreign language]
How did this single factor influence the commission rate in Q2? How big was the influence from mid-cap stock trading? What is a good indicator to track the change in US stock trading commission rate change? What is the fee rate in the distribution of funds and money market funds? What could be a good timing for considering issuing dividends? Thanks.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language]
Hu Shen
Director, CLSA
[Foreign language]
Operator
Due to time constraints, I would now hand back to Daniel Yuan for any closing remarks. Please go ahead.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to the CEO and Head of Investor Relations, Futu Holdings
That concludes our call today. On behalf of the Futu management team, I would like to thank you for joining us today. If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me or any of our investor relations representatives. Thank you, and goodbye.
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, this concludes today's conference call. Thank you for participating. You may now disconnect.

content.text:
Operator
Hello, ladies and gentlemen. Welcome to Futu Holdings Q1 2024 Earnings Conference Call. At this time, all participants are in a listen-only mode. After management's prepared remarks, there will be a question and answer session. Today's conference call is being recorded. If you have any objections, you may disconnect at this time. I'd now like to turn the conference over to your host for today's conference call, Daniel Yuan, Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR at Futu Holdings. Please go ahead, sir.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
Thanks, operator, and thank you for joining us today to discuss our Q1 2024 earnings results. Joining me on the call today are Mr. Leaf Li, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Arthur Chen, Chief Financial Officer, and Robin Xu, Senior Vice President. As a reminder, today's call may include forward-looking statements, which represent the company's belief regarding future events, which by their nature are not certain and are outside of the company's control, involving inherent risks and uncertainties. We caution you that a number of important factors could cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statements. For more information about the potential risks and uncertainties, please refer to the company's filings with the SEC, including its annual report. With that, I will now turn the call over to Leaf. Leaf will make his comments in Chinese, and I will translate.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] Thank you all for joining our earnings call today.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] Thank you all for joining our earnings call today. Boosted by strong market performance and solid execution in new markets, we wrapped up the quarter with approximately 1.9 million paying clients, representing a 24% growth year-over-year. In Q1, we added 177,000 paying clients, which more than quadrupled from the year-ago quarter, marking the third-highest quarterly growth in history. Three months into the year, we have already achieved over 50% of our full-year guidance of 350,000 net new paying clients. Given the year-to-date momentum, we would like to raise this guidance to 400,000 for now. Despite the rapid expansion of our client base, our quarterly paying client retention rate remained above 98%.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] Hong Kong and Singapore.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] Client acquisition in Hong Kong and Singapore both accelerated to double-digit sequential growth. Yet their contribution to new paying clients dwindled to around 1/3 amidst strong triple-digit new paying client growth in other markets.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] In Japan.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] In Japan, our continued focus on refining product experience and streamlining the account opening process, coupled with targeted marketing initiatives, led to robust growth in new paying clients and average client assets. In addition, our moomoo app continued to garner user interest in Japan, with cumulative downloads reaching one million in May.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 客户参与度和交易活跃度也超过了我们的预期。上线证券业务仅六周，我们便吸引了超过十万的开户客户，moomoo也成为当地下载量最多的金融类APP。尽管二季度以来获客速度有所放缓，我们认为马来西亚在今年仍能贡献可观的有资产客户数。我们将不断深耕，以保持我们的领先地位，并扩大市场份额。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] In Malaysia, our industry-leading trading experience, rich market information and data, interactive social community, and superior brand equity led to an above-expectation growth. Client engagement and trading velocity also surprised us on the upside. Within six weeks of our brokerage business launch in Malaysia, we attracted over 100,000 registered clients and became the most downloaded financial app. Though client acquisition decelerated into Q2, we still expect meaningful contribution from Malaysia for the rest of the year and are committed to defending and extending our market leadership.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 我们在每个市场都规划了丰富的交易品类和产品特性的上线计划。三月下旬，我们在日本上线了日股交易功能，并在四月将这一功能开放给香港和新加坡客户。我们还计划未来几个季度内在日本上线碎股交易、NISA储蓄账户、融资交易和共同基金，进一步扩充我们的产品品类。我们也将在香港和新加坡上线加密货币交易服务，预计这一交易品类的货币化率比股票交易高很多。在澳大利亚，我们最近上线了美股碎股、美股期权和美股定投。在加拿大，我们上线了退休储蓄账户和免税储蓄账户这两种注册账户类型，以及美股期权交易功能，并有计划未来上线港股交易功能。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] We have a rich pipeline of new products and features in all markets. In late March, we launched Japan equities trading in Japan and subsequently in Hong Kong and Singapore in April. We also intend to launch fractional shares trading, NISA savings account, margin trading, and mutual funds in Japan in the coming quarters. We'll also start offering crypto trading in Hong Kong and Singapore, and we expect much higher take rates than equities trading. In Australia, we recently launched fractional shares, options, and recurring investments for US stock trading. In Canada, we introduced self-directed registered retirement savings plan, tax-free savings account, US options trading, and will soon roll out Hong Kong stock trading.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 客户总资产环比增长7%，同比增长11%，达到5,180亿港币。各市场的净入金都维持了强劲势头，这抵消了因为一些科技股的下跌对客户港股持仓市值带来的负面影响。在新加坡，随着客户持续入金流入股市和现金管理类产品，客户总资产和复金资产分别环比增长25%和15%。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] Total client assets increased by 11% year over year and 7% quarter-over-quarter to HKD 518 billion. We continue to experience strong asset inflow across all markets, which more than offset the drag on clients' Hong Kong stock holdings from the market depreciation of several technology names. In Singapore, total client assets and average client assets recorded 25% and 15% sequential growth, respectively, driven by robust net asset inflow into equities and cash management products.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 总交易量环比提升40%，达到1.3万亿港币。港股交易量环比增长18%至2,800亿港币。客户对科技股、高股息股以及杠杆ETF的交易热情有明显上涨。另一方面，围绕人工智能和加密货币相关股票的交易活跃度，推动美股交易量环比提升48%，达到1万亿港币。本季度两融余额环比提升14%至380亿港币，达到历史新高水平。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] Total trading volume rebounded substantially by 40% quarter-over-quarter to HKD 1.3 trillion. In Hong Kong, trading volume grew by 18% sequentially to HKD 280 billion. Clients showed heightened interest in technology and high dividend names, as well as leveraged and inverse ETFs. High turnover of crypto and AI-themed stocks helped US stock trading volume jump by 48% sequentially to HKD 1 trillion. Margin financing and securities lending balance increased by 14% sequentially to a record high of HKD 38 billion.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 财富管理客户总资产达到640亿港币，同比增长73%，环比增长11%。一季度，随着客户入金流入美国国债，债券资产余额环比提升21%。在新加坡，货币基金持续受到客户青睐，财富管理资产规模保持了强劲的增长势头，同比提升356%，环比提升37%。为满足投资者追求高股息率产品的需求，我们推出了高派息稳健配置策略的基金组合。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] Total client assets in wealth management were HKD 64 billion, up 73% year-over-year and 11% quarter-over-quarter. In Q1, bond holdings increased by 21% sequentially, thanks to robust inflow in US. Treasury bills. In Singapore, wealth management asset balance grew by 356% year-over-year and 37% quarter-over-quarter as money market funds continued to gain traction. To cater to investor demand for high dividend yield, we launched a fund portfolio with high dividend stable allocation strategy.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 截至一季度，我们的企业服务有430家IPO分销和IR客户，同比增长22%。超过1,200家公司在我们的社区内开设了企业号和零售投资者交流。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] As of quarter end, we have 430 IPO distribution and IR clients, up 22% year-over-year. Over 1,200 companies have set up enterprise accounts in our social community to interact with retail investors.
Leaf Li
Chairman and CEO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 接下来有请我们的首席财务官Arthur介绍我们的财务表现。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] Next, I'd like to invite our CFO, Arthur Chen, to discuss our financial performance.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
Thank you, Leaf and Daniel. Please allow me to walk you through our financial performance in Q1. All the numbers are in Hong Kong dollars unless otherwise noted. Total revenue was HKD 2.6 billion, up 4% from HKD 2.5 billion in Q1 2023. Brokerage commission and handling charge income was HKD 1.1 billion, up 20% Q over Q and largely flat year-over-year. With client trading interest piling on AI and the crypto scene stocks with high stock price, the blended commission rate decreased from 8.8 basis points to 8.1 basis points due to our per share pricing model in the US. As a result, brokerage income grow at a slower rate than trading volume, both Q-over-Q and year-over-year.
Interest income was HKD 1.4 billion, up 5% year-over-year, and 1% Q-over-Q. The year-over-year increase was mainly driven by higher margin financing income due to an increase in daily average margin balance and higher interest income from bank deposits. The Q-over-Q increase was mostly driven by higher interest income from bank deposits due to the increase in daily average idle cash balance. Other income was HKD 156 million, up 24% year-over-year and 14% Q-over-Q. The year-over-year increase was primarily attributable to higher fund distribution income, and the Q-over-Q increase was mainly driven by higher currency exchange income. Our total costs were HKD 417 million, an increase of 62% from HKD 291 million in Q1 2023.
Brokerage commission and handling charge expenses were HKD 16 million, down 17% year-over-year and up 2% Q over Q. Brokerage expenses didn't move in tandem with brokerage income year-over-year, mainly due to cost saving from our US self-clearing business. Expenses grew at a narrow margin than income sequentially due to a non-recurring cost associated with self-clearing migration of Singapore stocks during Q4 2023. Interest expenses were HKD 313 million, up 139% year-over-year, and 16% Q-over-Q. The year-over-year increase was driven by higher interest expenses associated with our security borrowing and the lending business. The Q-over-Q increase was mostly due to a similar reasons, partially offset by lower margin financing interest expenses. Processing and the servicing costs were HKD 97 million, up 11% year-over-year and down 6% Q-over-Q.
The year-over-year increase was largely due to higher product service and the data transmission fees for new markets. The Q-over-Q decline was mainly driven by lower market information and the data fees, as well as lower product service fees. As a result, total gross profit was HKD 2.1 billion, a decrease of 4% from HKD 2.2 billion in Q1 2023. Gross margin was 81.9% as compared to 88.4% in the year-ago quarter. Operating expenses was up 16% year-over-year, and a 2% Q-over-Q to HKD 913 million. R&D expenses was HKD 336 million, down 5% year-over-year, and 7% Q-over-Q. The year-over-year and the Q-over-Q decrease was largely due to stricter cost control.
Sales and marketing expenses were HKD 293 million, up 107% year-over-year, and 6% quarter-over-quarter. The increase was driven by our triple-digit year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter growth in net new paying clients, partially offset by lower client acquisition costs. G&A expenses was HKD 301 million, down 2% year-over-year and 19% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year decrease was mainly due to lower professional service fees, and the quarter-over-quarter decrease was due to stricter cost control. As a result, income from operations declined 15% year-over-year and increased by 17% quarter-over-quarter to HKD 1.2 billion. Operating margin declined to 46% from 56.2% in Q1 2023, mostly due to higher marketing expenses.
Our net income decreased by 13% year-over-year and increased by 18% Q-over-Q to HKD 1 billion. Net income margin declined to 39.9% in Q1 as compared to 47.7% in Q1 last year. Our effective tax rate for Q1 was 15.2%. That concludes our prepared remarks. We'd now like to open the call to questions. Operator, please go ahead.
Operator
Thank you. We will now begin the question and answer session. To ask a question, please press star one one on your telephone. You will then hear an automated message advising your hand is raised. To withdraw your question, please press star one one again. Please stand by while we compile the Q&A roster. Once again, it's star one one for questions. Our first question comes from the line of Chiyao Huang from Morgan Stanley. Please ask your question, Chio.
Chiyao Huang
Research Analyst, Morgan Stanley
[Foreign language] 好的，感谢管理层给我第一个提问的机会。首先非常恭喜公司取得非常亮眼的获客和经营成绩。我想再有两个问题具体请教一下。第一就是关于日本，咱们现在管理层是否给更多的color，在有资产用户的数量和人均资产目前这么一个进度，而且如果咱们看从user到paying clients的转换率来说的话，那日本和别的其他的这些海外市场在相同的阶段对比起来，那目前处于一个大概是什么趋势，中间是否有一些转换率上的差别？这是第一个问题。第二个问题是关于咱们看到从三四月份之后整个市场的反弹，我们相信对香港的客户，他的交易活跃度和入金可能也会带来一个比较明显的提振。毕竟在赚钱效应之下，我们觉得这些帮助可能会比较明显。所以请管理层分享一下在二季度咱们目前看到的整个中国相关资产的反弹，对咱们具体的经营上，包括客户的投资换手率，还有入金上面有哪些新的帮助？谢谢。我简单翻译一下。So I got two questions.
[Translator] First question is regarding the progress we are making in Japan in terms of the number of paying clients, the per client AUM, and also want to have more you know view on the conversion rate from the app user to paying clients. Is there any difference we are seeing in Japan right now compared to other international markets at a similar stage? Wonder if management could give more color on that. Second question is regarding into Q2, we're seeing pretty strong rebound in the China-related assets in Hong Kong and in the US as well. Wonder what's the help we are seeing right now in terms of client trading activity and fund inflows in Q2 so far we are seeing. Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
Thank you, Chio. Let my colleague Daniel to answer your first question and I will address your second question sequentially. Thank you.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] Chio 你好，那关于第一个日本的这个问题，那我们在日本的获客的这个速度，我们看到的是季度环比会有比较明显的一个提升，那一季度相比四季度有非常明显的提升，那二季度可能四五月份的数据来看，相比一季度也是有一个比较不错的一个提升，而且在我们整体的竞争客户，这个竞争付费客户的这个比例还是非常可观的。那在平均客户资产这一块，目前我们觉得还是在一个比较早期的这个爬坡的阶段，但是我们能够明显地看到不同 cohort 的客户都有持续地放新的钱到我们这个账户里面。那关于这个转化率，那从 user 到这个有资产客户的转化率，日本我们觉得随着我们这个黄金流程体验上各方面一些改善，然后随着我们品类的一些上线，我们看到这个转化率是比较明显的，在 Q on Q 的提升，但是跟其他海外市场比，无论是现在的这个数据，还是其他市场崭新这个初期的数据，我们还是看到了非常大的一个 gap。我们觉得这个更多的可能是跟可能开户的一些体验，我们觉得有比较大的一些关系。当然非常大的一个另外一个因素也是品类的这个齐全度吧。刚才其实 Leaf 也提到了，我们这个未来几个季度有非常这个丰富的一个产品上线的一个计划。So for Japan, we are seeing very meaningful growth in terms of new paying clients.
[Translator] We saw strong sequential growth in Q1 and Q2 to date. We observed similar strong Q-on-Q momentum. In terms of client AUM, I think we are still in the early innings of attracting client assets, but we have seen across client cohorts that they continue to put assets onto our platform. In terms of conversion from users to paying clients, that conversion ratio has improved quarter-over-quarter, thanks to a better account opening process and with more financial products rolled out on our platform. There is still a significant gap in comparison to other overseas markets, whether it's current percentages or when they were first, when we first launched into that market.
I think this is more the reason because of the account opening friction and the lack of comprehensive financial products. As Leaf mentioned in his opening remarks, we have a very rich product pipeline coming up in Japan in the coming quarters. Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 好的，那第二个问题我来回答一下。从二季度的表现来看，确实像Chio你讲的一样，我们看到香港市场是有一个非常强劲的反弹，这个对于我们整个香港客户的获取，包括入金，还有交易量都能看到一个持续的改善。从一季度的数据，大家也能看到，前面Leaf也有讲到，整个我们一季度的交易量里面，大概美股的交易量占比大概是超过75%的。那么从二季度quarter to date的这个情况来看，因为受到港股的反弹，港股的交易量是有一个比较明显的提升的。那我相信，不同市场的这个交易量的比例，从二季度来看也是会更加均匀。那么第二，在一季度的数据里面，我们实际录得了一个非常强的净入金水平，整体的净入金是超过HKD 350亿。那得益于我们在香港市场、新加坡市场以及我们新进入的一些市场的强劲表现。从第二季度目前截止到目前的情况来看，这个良好的表现也是得到了一个非常强劲的持续。所以从净入金还有客户的总资产的角度，我们依然看到一个非常良好的增长。那从获客的角度来说，在第一季度我们已经获取了17万的有资产的客户。当然有一部分的客户增长是得益于我们在马来西亚新进入的市场，开局的非常好的表现。那么二季度目前的情况来看，整体的情况相比一季度会有所放缓，因为像马来西亚这些市场的一些情况会更加正常化，但是绝对的获客数量依然保持着一个非常强劲的水平。Let me translate for myself.
[Translator] Number one is we definitely see a very strong momentum recovery in Hong Kong markets, which significantly help our clients' asset inflows in Hong Kong. Overall, in terms of trading volume, trading velocity, etc., as Leaf Li mentioned in the opening remarks, in Q1, in terms of the trading volume breakdowns, the US stock trading accounts for roughly, you know, over 75% of our total trading volume, and we do expect this ratio will become more healthy, given the more contributions in Hong Kong stock in Q2.
Number two is in Q1, we recorded very strong net asset inflows, which roughly over HKD 35 billion, thanks to very strong inflow from our existing markets in Hong Kong and in Singapore, etc. Also, incremental contributions from new markets such as Malaysia and Japan, etc. We do believe such momentum remains in Q2 to date. You know, this will significantly help in terms of the client assets and the trading volume, etc. Thirdly, despite you know we already achieved over 170 funded accounts in Q1, partially due to some special reasons in Malaysia, due to our grand opening in Q1.
We do think the overall momentum on absolute terms remain very strong, despite we expect there can be some Q-over-Q you know decrease due to a very high base in Q1. Thank you.
Chiyao Huang
Research Analyst, Morgan Stanley
[Foreign language] 非常感谢。
Operator
Thank you. As a reminder, to ask a question, please press star one one on your telephone keypad. Our next question comes from the line of Katherine Lei from J.P. Morgan. Please ask your question, Katherine.
Katherine Lei
VP and Equity Research Analyst, J.P. Morgan
Hi, can you hear me clearly? [Foreign language] 各位管理层你好。
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
Yes。
Katherine Lei
VP and Equity Research Analyst, J.P. Morgan
[Foreign language] 我是摩根大通的分析师。谢谢您给我这个提问的机会。我这边主要有两个问题，第一个就是说在马来西亚这边，管理层可不可以给我们再细化讲一下，就是说马来西亚这些客户的客户画像是怎么样的，然后他们主要的这个trading pattern，比如说他们的换手率这些大概是什么样的一个状况。然后因为之前我们的交流，就是说这一方面的话，这些客户还是挺活跃的，您觉得这个是因为某一些事件driven就是比较暂时比较活跃，还是说这个区域的客户就会是特别的活跃，就是这个可持续度大概有多大？给我们讲一下这个市场的一些主要的概况。谢谢。 第二个问题我想问一下，就是这个佣金费率的，因为刚刚管理层也有讲到佣金费率的话，在季度环比的时候其实是有一个比较明显的下滑。那一部分是因为管理层也解释了，是因为美国这边的这个收费的这个structure的一个问题。但就是说在二季度的时候，随着China ADR Stock就是一些比较没那么大的小票的一些反弹，然后还有比如说NVIDIA的stock split各种的一些因素的话，那我们是不是可以预期在二季度的时候，环比的时候，这一个佣金费率下滑的趋势是有所缓解的，我们要怎么去看这个趋势的问题，谢谢。
[Translator] First, it's about the Malaysia market. I will appreciate if management can give us some color on the Malaysia market like I heard that clients are very active in trading, like is that one-off or event driven or is that a persisting trend? The second question will be more on the commission rates. Do you think that we will see some sequential improvement in the sequential rate? How should we form our expectation? Thank you.
Arthur Chen
CFO, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 谢谢 Katherine。我来回答，先回答一下第二个问题，然后第一个问题，有关一些这个 unique economics 的问题我会来回答，然后到时候再请我的同事 Robin 来补充一下马来西亚客户的一个画像好吗？那有关这个费率方面的东西，第一，我们之前也已经解释了，确实是在这个一季度，整体我们的客户交易高价的美国股票的占比相对是比较大的，所以导致 like for like，我们会有一个佣金收费率的一个下降。那我预计在二季度这个情况会有一个比较明显的改善。一方面是得益于整体，就像 Catherine 你刚才讲到的，比如有一些高价的股票，像 NVIDIA，这些会有股票的分拆，从六月一号开始，那么这个会缓解我们的收费模式带来的一个不利的情况在里面。那么从二季度目前看到的情况来看，整个二季度我们目前的综合费率也是相比一季度保持一个平稳的状态，没有进一步的下跌的情况。
[Translator] Let me translate for myself for the second question first. I think the blended commission rate decrease was mainly due to you know, our pricing model in the US stock market, as we mentioned before. Quarter to date, we have seen the ratio has already become more stable, partially due to there were some high-value stock such as NVIDIA, etc., in the US will conduct a stock split. This will alleviate the pricing pressure in the US.
[Foreign language] 有关第一个问题就是，马来西亚那边的客户的一些交易的一些换手率，从目前来看，因为我们进入这个市场的这个时间还是比较短的。但是从目前我们看到的客户的一些数据，无论从客户的入金也好，客户的交易量也好，客户的一些换手率也好，整体马来西亚的客户表现的这个情况来看，要比我们整体海外平均市场的这个水平是要高不少的。所以呢，基本上从目前几个月的这个情况来看，我们并没有感觉这方面的一些，这个特征是一些，就是暂时性的一些事件的一些原因。那么当然这我们可能需要更多的一些时间来做一些相应的一些观察。那么具体客户画像方面的一些情况，我请 Robin 在我翻译之后再来补充，好吗？In terms of unit economics in Malaysia so far, on a cohort basis, we have witnessed a very healthy organic growth in terms of cash inflow, then clients trading velocity and also the trading volume, etc.
[Translator] It seems that all these metrics in Malaysia are well above the average situations of our overall overseas markets. Of course, it is maybe still too early to say, given that we just entered into Malaysia a couple of months ago. We will still keep you know closely monitoring. But having said that, we think you know the user behavior demonstrated so far is not just one-off because of some one-off events. Thank you.
Robin Xu
SVP, Futu Holdings
[Foreign language] 好的，感谢提问。我来回答一下第一个问题。
[Foreign language] 感谢提问。我来回答一下第一个问题。那我们是在今年的二月底，最后一周是在马来西亚正式上线了我们的证券业务，然后获客是非常的迅猛。那一季度为集团贡献了差不多有三分之一的净增有资产客户。那我们用了四十九天的时间做到了，马来西亚历史的累积下载第一名。那我们现在也是目前马来西亚排名第一的券商下载量。那能在这么短的时间里触达精准人群，我觉得主要是得益于以下几个方面。那首先我们在新加坡已经是成为第一大的科技券商，并且有着非常良好的口碑。那新加坡的品牌影响力对马来西亚市场是有较大的辐射作用和品牌的溢出作用。那其次，我们提供了马来西亚市场上最好的投资产品的工具，那一站式的投资马股和美股的交易，包括免费的实时行情和资讯服务。那无论是从产品能力还是从产品体验上，都是行业的领先地位。最后就是，有大量早期积累的用户在第一季度集中转化为有资产客户，那这对我们的获客也有显著的贡献。那另外就是展业初期，马来西亚的市场获客是强劲的，而且是大幅超出了集团的预期。那么从第二季度开始，马来西亚这边是对于集团的获客贡献会有一定比例的下降。那这主要原因是我们在开户和出入金以及内部团队的运营的电子化和自动化程度上，还没有完全跟得上我们整个前端的获客节奏。那为了确保我们前端的客户的体验更为流畅，提高团队的电子化的效率，那我们也适当把握获客的节奏，动态关注和监测这些客户的数据模型，以便更科学地运营和开拓市场。那最后就是我们在马来西亚市场的客户画像，主要是以男性为主，而且是收入偏高的男性。另外就是从种族来看，我们目前更大的比例是来自于华人。所以这可能某种程度上来解释了，就为什么在马来西亚市场上客户的交易是比较频繁，而且从经济模型来看，目前还是表现得非常不错的。好，谢谢。
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
[Translator] We officially launched our brokerage business in Malaysia by the end of February, and we've experienced very rapid growth. In Q1, Malaysia contributed about 1/3 of our net new paying clients. Within 49 days of official brokerage business launch, we achieved number one in total cumulative downloads in Malaysia. I think the reason why we can grow so quickly in Malaysia can be attributed to several factors. First of all, we were already the biggest online broker in Singapore when we entered in Malaysia, and that brought us a lot of brand recognition. Secondly, we simply just offer the best product in Malaysia, a one-stop platform where you can invest in Malaysian equities, US equities, and we have free market data and information, which are all industry-leading.
Last but not least, we have also accumulated a large number of users before our official brokerage business launch, and we were able to convert a very meaningful chunk of those users. I think the Q1 growth was above our expectations. Going to the Q2, we believe the contribution of Malaysia will come down sequentially. That is because there is still room for improvement in terms of the level of automation in client account opening, asset inflow and outflow, and in operations, et cetera. In order to ensure that our clients then have a very smooth experience and to increase our operational efficiency, I think we dynamically adjust our client acquisition pace, and so on, so as to better inform our growth in Malaysia.
In terms of our client profiles, most of our clients in Malaysia are male and have higher income. In terms of ethnicity, a lot of them are the Chinese population. I think that partly explains the high trading turnover and relatively higher average assets than we expected, which will probably lead to a favorable payback period in Malaysia. Thank you.
Operator
Right. Thank you. Once again, to ask a question, please press star one one on your telephone. Right. I'm showing no further questions. I'll now turn the conference back to Mr. Daniel Yuan for closing comments.
Daniel Yuan
Chief of Staff to CEO and Head of IR, Futu Holdings
That concludes our call today. On behalf of the Futu management team, I would like to thank you for joining us today. If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me or any of our investor relations representatives. Thank you and goodbye.
Operator
Thank you. That concludes today's conference call. Thank you for participating. You may now disconnect.
